Bettina, the official handover was 3-Nov-2025. I replied in the thread in #coastal-team.

Moss's Coastal digest from 2-Nov-2025 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow". Your own recap note from 8-Dec-2025 also gives 3-Nov-2025 as the official handoff.

The recap says you kept running PHL day to day until 21-Nov-2025, and Kwame fully took over on 22-Nov-2025. I told you to use 3-Nov-2025 for the tracker unless you track the day-to-day takeover instead.

I wrote the dates in your day-month-year format.
